Proof simplification proposal(s)
Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into codex/zfc-equation-reduction-46be

Record reviewed upstream merge after closing the external current-equation iff

Preserve the independent11-module proof-source audit, exact old interface/data checks and scoped upstream build evidence. Record the clean merge of origin60fcb2a69b, including two additional inert packet placements, without executing or adopting their proposals. Confirm decimal/distinct-name artifacts and separate pre-merge leaf checks from the planned authenticated post-merge closure validation.

Inline list-lookup wrappers and finish the intake session's simplifications

These are the intake session's last queued proof simplifications, left
after the research session adopted the overlapping proposals.

- Annotated{ProofChecker,Rename,RuleSide,Assumption,Bound}: the seven
  private one-line wrappers around List.mem_of_getElem? and
  List.getElem?_of_mem are deleted, and their twelve call sites call
  the core lemmas directly.
- SelectiveCoefficientBounds.half_base_bound: the 2^t = 2 * 2^(t-1)
  step is `rw [← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel ht]` instead of a
  three-line congr/omega proof (packet f, T03).
- tools/generate_{split,gap}_recipe_steps*.py: both Steps generators
  now read and write UTF-8 with LF. On Windows the default cp1252
  write had truncated a Lean file to 0 bytes and emitted CRLF, and the
  split generator's --check misread the file. Both --check runs pass.
- SHORT_REDUCED_STRONG.md: the generator no longer emits a degree
  certificate. The bound is proved by total_degree_bound after one
  ring identity.
- ADOPTION.md records these rows as adopted.

Checked serially with LAKE_JOBS=1 and LEAN_NUM_THREADS=0, one module
per lake invocation, against the current tree: 25 lake builds, among
them all six edited modules and the annotated scanner, context and
rule modules that depend on them. All are green.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into codex/zfc-equation-reduction-46be

Prove the current four frontier equations equivalent to actual ConZFC in Lean

Construct positive coordinates of the literal maintained14-variable polynomial from negated syntactic consistency, with every scalar supplied by the same calibrated packing and both Pell seeds freshly derived. Compose the exact current soundness endpoint to prove no-positive-zero iff DiophantineConsistency.ConZFC, with no tiling, mask, rank or desired-zero premise.

Transfer the closed equivalence to all three accepted13-variable forms at the actual fixed ports, and construct one positive13-coordinate assignment solving all three simultaneously under negated consistency. Add focused pointwise-domain checks, six standard-only axiom audits, independent private replay and precise source/object receipts. Update the proof plan and preserve the separate encoded internal-ZFC/nonstandard obligation and ongoing size-reduction goal.

Construct both native Pell seeds and all positive source coordinates

Derive the exact outer seed from odd rank and binary population, including the q-cubed scale, strict doubled-ordinate interval, both norms and positive quotient witnesses. Combine it with a fresh compatible private seed, prove every canonical block, restore all 31 positive natural coordinates and all 22 literal rows, and obtain the actual positive Carrier65 zero from explicit scalar data.

Record independent capped leaf replay and twelve standard-only axiom reports. Authenticate the fresh current Ratio90/Half prerequisite objects while preserving the stale shared cache and documenting reused closure scope. Add the packets to the umbrella and maintain the proof plan without claiming the separate internal-ZFC equivalence.

Calibrate the actual packing rank and force its temporal multiplier

Compose safe finite dummy mutation with the literal full-modulus controller. Bind the resulting signed rank to the same source and normalization, derive its population/residue/growth, and rephase the same carries and digits to the positive quotient stride. Prove the ordinary temporal multiplier equals 2^(R-width*N).

Derive the controller size hypotheses from independently cofinal actual Wang dimensions, then construct the transparent native packing from an actual blank halt or negated syntactic ConZFC. No desired masks, support, calibrated rank, source zero or tiling is supplied. Add author, root and independent capped Lean replay receipts; all fourteen packet axiom reports are standard-only. Positive Pell assembly and internal ZFC remain separate. Preserve decimal/distinct-name equation artifacts.

Place two more DiophantineConsistency Lean simplification packets

Recheck the user-facing equation notation: all 715 packed digits are decimal, all 14 unknowns are distinct and unsubscripted, and PDF text agrees with the TeX. A fresh pdflatex build reproduces the committed one-page PDF byte for byte. Both maintained artifacts remain unchanged.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Prove finite Boolean accumulation, actual rank parity and the derived temporal stride

Construct every finite safe update from the original normalization and derive exact ordinary C/F and rank sums. Derive rank three modulo four from the literal adjusted low mask while retaining one coherent rank/population/growth witness.

Derive divisibility, positive quotient stride, cyclic equality and exact temporal power from the explicit rank congruence; preserve the same source, carries and normalized F under rephasing. Record precise author/root/independent replay scopes and thirty-two standard-only audits. Leave actual rank binding into the stride adapter and remaining Pell/source assembly to integration.

Transport internal polynomial satisfaction through environment restriction

Use surjectivity of restriction along injective Fin.val to quantify over every finite internal tuple. Supply the existing empty-set value as the default extension, covering zero variables without any new model assumption. An explicit guarded predicate makes elaboration reliable. Also derive equationForm semantics directly from evalForm_spec and the unchanged shifted binder environment. Formula data and all public statements are preserved; 98 lines become 82.

Validation: refreshed target and the shared syntax target, all three direct clients, three existing compiler/object checks and all 15 public axiom comparisons pass in the joint nine-call final suite. All old reports are byte-identical. The first unannotated environment-restriction proof failed motive inference; adding the explicit predicate fixed the target, with no cache or import adjustment. Independent full-source review confirms arbitrary internal/nonstandard tuples and the zero-variable case.

Use list-sum algebra for sparse syntax coefficient proofs

Relate the existing recursive interpretation to its list sum once. Derive append, negation, multiplication and coefficient transport from standard list sum and monomial laws, and reuse equivalence injectivity for exponent vectors. This replaces repeated inductions without changing the executable sparse expansion, coefficient reader or any old public statement. Charging the private helper and added import, the module shrinks from 120 to 110 lines.

Validation with the ObjectPolynomial port: two refreshed targets, three direct clients, CompilerAxioms/ObjectAxioms/ObjectOmegaSemiring and all 15 old public axiom reports pass (nine final calls after baseline). All old reports are byte-identical. Independent full-source review checks empty lists, duplicate and cancelling terms and actual library contracts. The separate ObjectPolynomial first attempt needed an explicit predicate annotation; no SyntaxCoefficients repair was needed.

Reuse the existing Jones syntax evaluation bridges

Expose the five established radicand, weight, divisor, dividend and margin evaluation lemmas in JonesSyntax. ExecutableJones uses those same generic lemmas instead of repeating their proofs. All existing public statement types, imports and 21 executable definition regions are unchanged; no new helper proof is added. The two modules shrink from 479 to 430 lines.

Validation: both refreshed modules, all four direct production clients, the existing 63-endpoint CompilerAxioms check, 26-old-result axiom comparison and five newly public bridge audits pass (nine final calls after the baseline). Old reports are byte-identical; bridges use only standard Lean axioms. All ten total calls passed first try. Independent complete-source review passes for both frozen files.

Simplify the native quadratic position bound to its last-row frontier

Use the generic natural subtraction bound for rows 0 through 20, whose targets are already below 7516. Only row 21 needs its actual supported entries checked: retain its five exact decide cases. Preserve the 22-row table, weights, coefficients, public statements and all four ports unchanged. The complete module shrinks from 258 to 177 lines without a helper or import.

Validation: refreshed named module, both direct production clients, three existing focused checks and all 15 old public axiom reports pass (seven final Lean calls plus the baseline). Reports are byte-identical. Independent complete-source review confirms the generic bound and all five frontier values. No failures, cache gaps or retries.

Construct safe physical supports for arbitrary Gamma-weighted controller targets

Prove the generic natural-to-cyclic support power-sum identity with exact optional-cell multiplicity, then combine actual subset selection, canonical safe positions and the literal Gamma unit. Return a nonempty bounded-cardinality safe set for every full-modulus target without a supplied support, safety or unit premise.

Record full independent root review and fresh main/check replay with four standard-only audits, matching objects, optional-bit controls and target zero. Keep actual finite word mutation and final rank calibration as separate compositions.
